observations.summary: help.receiptFile repeats the recipient-binding overclaim when invoice context is available. Pay renders that help and passes the prepared address, but the binder intentionally skips recipient comparison when a valid minimal receipt omits stealthAddress.
observations.recommendation: Qualify both pay.receipt.intro and help.receiptFile on the receipt containing an address. Preserve intentional minimal receipts.

independent_confirmations.classification: Test qualification gap; not a demonstrated runtime vulnerability
independent_confirmations.summary: payBadMetadata reverts in its successful try body instead of persisting unexpected acceptance. With fail_on_revert=false, this handler revert is not itself a failing invariant. It rolls back the router call and handler state; later invariants have no recorded bad-metadata acceptance to detect.
limiting_evidence: Separate explicit unit rejection assertions read at GhostPayRouter.t.sol:339-373.
Separate metadata-amount fuzz rejection assertion read at GhostPayRouter.fuzz.t.sol:84-99.
independent_confirmations.recommendation: Persist unexpected success in a dedicated counter or flag and assert its absence in an invariant. Retain the separate unit/fuzz guards.
independent_confirmations.validation: Static source inference. No harness, mutation, build or test executed.

independent_confirmations.summary: payFotToken has empty success and catch bodies. FOT-specific properties only check router retention; recipient accounting uses the ordinary token. Successful lossy forwarding with no FOT retained by the router would not violate those properties.
limiting_evidence: The mock rounds burns up; every nonzero transfer is lossy.

independent_confirmations.recommendation: Record successful lossy-token calls as a persistent property failure and separately track exercise of the negative path.
